scenes.summary: 主持人聊端午節與故事預告
scenes.prompt: Warm podcast intro mood, hosts chatting about Dragon Boat Festival traditions before the story begins, cozy studio feeling
Little red race car sniffing a delicious aroma drifting through a colorful clay amusement park, curious hungry mood
A cute round pink food truck rolling into the car playground with shiny windows and a friendly smile, festive arrival mood
Close view of the pink food truck wearing two green zongzi like cute hair clips, leaf-wrapped triangles swaying gently, playful detail mood
The pink food truck smiling at the little red race car beside a string of tasty zongzi, friendly introduction mood
The pink food truck serving festival zongzi at a cheerful stall in the amusement park, sweet and savory treats on display, welcoming mood
Little red race car asking curiously while the pink food truck opens its window under a shady tree, gentle question mood
Soft storytelling scene by the riverside, the pink food truck narrating a caring scholar named Qu Yuan who loved his country, calm educational mood
Simple clay boats on gentle river water, people searching and offering leaf-wrapped rice to the water, respectful remembrance mood, toddler-safe
Little red race car having an aha moment connecting dragon boat racing and zongzi to the old story, bright understanding mood
The pink food truck explaining that zongzi also means remembering gratitude and thanks, warm heartfelt mood
Little red race car eager for hot zongzi but stopping itself to wait in line politely, gentle self-control mood
Little red race car queuing behind a yellow excavator, both smiling patiently at the pink food truck stall, polite friendship mood
Little red race car politely asking for one zongzi with a thankful smile, the pink food truck handing it over warmly, courteous exchange mood
Friends under a shady tree unwrapping steaming zongzi together, fragrant steam rising, cozy sharing mood
Little red race car tasting zongzi while the yellow excavator nods, realizing food can carry memory and care, tender mood
Little red race car, yellow excavator, and pink food truck looking peacefully toward the horizon together after eating, grateful friendship mood
Happy vehicles in the amusement park reflecting on learning the Dragon Boat Festival story while enjoying zongzi, satisfied mood
Gentle closing scene with zongzi and soft festival decorations, feeling of thanks, remembrance, and wishes for health and peace
Cheerful farewell at the car playground entrance, friends waving goodbye after a warm festival day, cozy ending mood
